source: The paper observes that quantization error is not equally important across weight channels. Activation statistics are used to identify salient channels, and an equivalent per-channel scaling transformation reduces the error on important weights without storing a mixed-precision set of protected weights.
zh: 该论文观察到，量化误差在权重通道中并不同样重要。激活统计数据用于识别显着通道，等效的每通道缩放变换可减少重要权重的误差，而无需存储受保护权重的混合精度集。
